title: Dive Kit Checklists Schema
description: The checklist presets of the Dive Kit app: editable starting templates of ordered sections and steps, each step with optional details, a timer and a notes field. English is the base text; translations live in datasets/i18n/<locale>/checklists.json, keyed by the same ids.

generated_at.description: ISO timestamp when the dataset was last generated.

license.description: SPDX licence id of this file's content.

source.description: Where the content was taken from.

checklists.description: Presets in the order the app's picker lists them.

id.description: Stable checklist id in kebab-case. Example: 'rec-pre-dive'.

app_preset_id.description: The id the Dive Kit app records on a checklist made from this preset. Example: 'recPreDive'.

description.description: English one-paragraph description: what the checklist is for and what it follows.

use.description: When the checklist is run. predive: before entering the water; ccr-build: assembling and testing a rebreather; in-water: surface checks after entry, before descent; dive-plan: reviewing the plan; post-dive: after the dive.

unit.description: The rebreather model the checklist is written for, or null when it is not unit-specific. A unit-specific checklist is valid for that unit only.

provenance.description: What the checklist follows and how closely.

basis.description: own-words: written for Dive Kit; paraphrased: follows a published check's structure in Dive Kit's words; reproduced: follows a published document's items and wording closely.

source.description: The procedure or document followed, with version or section where known.

agency.description: Id of the training agency in agencies.json whose procedure it follows, or null.

url.description: A link to the source, or null when none is published or recorded.

id.description: Stable section id: '<checklist id>-s<n>'. Ids are assigned once and never reused; order comes from the array, not the id.
Stable step id: '<section id>-<n>'. Assigned once and never reused.

label.description: English step text shown beside the checkbox.

description.description: Optional English detail: how or why.

notes.description: Present when the step has a free-text notes field (cell readings, gas analysis, pressures).
